title: Veterans Pension Maximum Annual Pension Rate Schedule
content:
# Veterans Pension — Maximum Annual Pension Rates

The maximum annual pension rate of each Veterans Pension rate category, effective December 1, 2025, is the figure below, in USD per year. Each category also carries an additional child increment, the amount added to the maximum annual pension rate for each additional dependent child, and a monthly rounding rule.

| Rate category | Maximum annual pension rate (USD per year) | Additional child increment (USD per year, per additional child) |
|---|---|---|
| Veterans Pension (Basic Rate, No Dependents) | 17440 | 2979 |
| Veterans Pension (Basic Rate, One Dependent) | 22838 | 2979 |
| Veterans Pension (Housebound, No Dependents) | 21312 | 2979 |
| Veterans Pension (Housebound, One Dependent) | 26712 | 2979 |
| Veterans Pension (Aid and Attendance, No Dependents) | 29092 | 2979 |
| Veterans Pension (Aid and Attendance, One Dependent) | 34487 | 2979 |

## Monthly rounding

In every rate category the monthly pension amount is rounded down to the whole dollar: cents are dropped, never rounded up.

## Reading the schedule

- The rate category held on the award selects the row; a one-dependent category and its no-dependent counterpart differ only by the figure in the second column.
- The child increment is the same 2979 in every category and is added once for each additional child.

### Worked figures (hypothetical inputs)

- An annual figure of exactly 17440 divided by twelve is 1453.33; rounded down to the whole dollar the monthly amount is 1453.
- An annual figure of 22838 divided by twelve is 1903.17; the monthly amount is 1903.
- An annual figure of 26712 divided by twelve is exactly 2226; nothing is dropped and the monthly amount is 2226.
